package main

import (
	"context"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
)

func main() {
	port := flag.Int("port", 8088, "HTTP port for MCP server")
	protocol := flag.String("protocol", "http", "Transport protocol: http or stdio")
	flag.Parse()

	slog.Info("CryptoMinute MCP Server", "version", "1.0.0", "protocol", *protocol)

	server := NewServer()

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()

	sigChan := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(sigChan, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)

	go func() {
		<-sigChan
		slog.Info("Shutdown signal received")
		cancel()
	}()

	switch *protocol {
	case "stdio":
		if err := server.ServeStdio(ctx); err != nil {
			slog.Error("Server failed", "error", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	case "http":
		addr := fmt.Sprintf(":%d", *port)
		slog.Info("HTTP server starting", "addr", addr)
		if err := server.ServeHTTP(ctx, addr); err != nil {
			slog.Error("Server failed", "error", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	default:
		slog.Error("Unsupported protocol", "protocol", *protocol)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	slog.Info("MCP server shutdown complete")
}
